R code for analyzing MC analysis results

## Initial setup

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source("FrontMatter.R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
load(paste(saveDIR, "eriedata_08_21.RData", sep="/"))
load(paste(saveDIR, "eriedata_08_24.RData", sep="/"))

packages(VGAM)  ## log1p_exp  ### doesn't work for rv objects
sHSM <- function(x, beta_0, beta_1, beta_2, phi, lambda){
  return(beta_0 + beta_1 * (x - phi) + 
           (beta_2-beta_1) * lambda * 
           log(1+exp((x-phi)/lambda)))
}

load(paste(saveDIR, "fitall1.RData", sep="/"))
load(paste(saveDIR, "input_to_stan.RData", sep="/"))
```

## Plotting the Fitted Model

Using the `rv package`: 

1. Extract model coefficients 
2. Extract annual data
3. Plotting the annual models

```{R}
#| label: extracting_model
md_mc <- fitall24
yrs <- 2008:2024
yy_mc <- "part_mc"
YL_mc <- "MC ($\\mu$g/L)"
plt_data <- eriedata08_24
lmbd_mc <- input.to.stan24$data$lambda
thr_mc <- 7
file_name_mc <- "/BHM_MC"
file_name_mc_log <- "/BHM_MC_log"

## annual model parameters -- mc


b0_mc  <- rvsims(as.matrix(md_mc$draws(variables = "b0", format = "df")))
b1_mc  <- rvsims(as.matrix(md_mc$draws(variables = "b1", format = "df")))
b2_mc  <- rvsims(as.matrix(md_mc$draws(variables = "b2", format = "df")))
phi_mc <- rvsims(as.matrix(md_mc$draws(variables = "phi", format = "df")))
sigma_mc <- rvsims(as.matrix(md_mc$draws(variables = "sigma", format = "df")))

## plotting data
plt_data$yrs <- (ordered(format(plt_data$Date, format="%Y")))
plt_data$days <- as.numeric(format(plt_data$Date, format="%j"))

day_range <- range(plt_data$days)
x_days <- seq(day_range[1], day_range[2],,100)

xyplot(log(part_mc)~days|yrs, data=plt_data)

## Using rv summary statistics
yr_lvl <- levels(plt_data$yrs)

## in log concentration -- MC
for (i in 1:length(yr_lvl)){
  temp1 <- plt_data[plt_data$yrs==yr_lvl[i],]
##  temp2 <- cbind(x_days, summary(exp(hockey_smooth(x=x_days, 
##                           beta0=b0[i], beta1=b1[i], 
##                           delta=b2[i]-b1[i],
##                           phi=phi[i]))))
  temp2 <- cbind(x_days, summary((hockey_smooth(x=x_days,
                                                beta0=b0_mc[i],
                                                beta1=b1_mc[i], 
                                        delta=b2_mc[i]-b1_mc[i],
                                                phi=phi_mc[i]))))
  names(temp2) <- c( "x_days", "mean", "sd", "X1",
                     "X2.5", "X25", "X50", "X75", "X97.5",
                     "X99", "sims" )
##  tikz(file=paste(plotDIR, file_name_mc_log, yr_lvl[i], 
##  ".tex", sep=""), height=4, width=5, standAlone = T)
  par(mar=c(4,3,3,1), mgp=c(1.5, 0.5,0), las=1, tck=-0.01)
  plot(temp1$days, log(temp1[,yy_mc]), type="n", 
       main=yr_lvl[i], xlab="Days since Jan 1", 
       ylab=YL_mc)
  polygon(x=c(temp2$x_days, rev(temp2$x_day)), 
          c(temp2$X2.5, rev(temp2$X97.5)),
          density=NA, col=gray(0.75))
  polygon(x=c(temp2$x_days, rev(temp2$x_day)), 
          c(temp2$X25, rev(temp2$X75)), 
          density=NA, col=gray(0.5))
  lines(temp2$x_days, temp2$mean, lwd=2)
  points(temp1$days, log(temp1[,yy_mc]), cex=0.75)  
##  dev.off()
}

## in concentration
for (i in 1:length(yr_lvl)){
  temp1 <- plt_data[plt_data$yrs==yr_lvl[i],]
  temp2 <- cbind(x_days, summary(exp(hockey_smooth(x=x_days,
                                                beta0=b0_mc[i],
                                                beta1=b1_mc[i], 
                                        delta=b2_mc[i]-b1_mc[i],
                                                phi=phi_mc[i]))))
  names(temp2) <- c( "x_days", "mean", "sd", "X1",
                     "X2.5", "X25", "X50", "X75", "X97.5",
                     "X99", "sims" )
##  tikz(file=paste(plotDIR, file_name_mc, yr_lvl[i], 
##  ".tex", sep=""), height=4, width=5, standAlone = T)
  par(mar=c(4,3,3,1), mgp=c(1.5, 0.5,0), las=1, tck=-0.01)
  plot(temp1$days, (temp1[,yy_mc]), type="n", 
       main=yr_lvl[i], xlab="Days since Jan 1", 
       ylab=YL_mc)
  polygon(x=c(temp2$x_days, rev(temp2$x_day)), 
          c(temp2$X2.5, rev(temp2$X97.5)),
          density=NA, col=gray(0.75))
  polygon(x=c(temp2$x_days, rev(temp2$x_day)), 
          c(temp2$X25, rev(temp2$X75)), 
          density=NA, col=gray(0.5))
  lines(temp2$x_days, temp2$mean, lwd=2)
  points(temp1$days, (temp1[,yy_mc]), cex=0.75)  
##  dev.off()
}

```
